name: EPIC 201651170
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 1, 16.4 solar radii and 0.79 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201651170 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM radius (solar radii) 16.369814 (16th-84th percentiles 15.783271-17.375767), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 5,672 parsecs away, 16 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 1, give 0.79 solar masses and 16.4 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,838 K at its surface.
